answer: Require both sides of every trade to lock matching escrow in a shared vault before anything moves: funds release only when both parties countersign completion. A lone honest agent pays nothing extra, since the vault returns the deposit on a clean deal. A sybil ring trading with itself must park real capital in every fake deal, and the escrow never leaves the circle: its haven of self-dealing becomes an oasis of frozen funds, earning nothing net while its capital sits locked.
